system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you would gain a bonus to hit or damage, you may spend a reaction and 1 Superiority Die. When you do, you attempt to drain a bit of their power through their shadow, into your own. They must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) save DC. On a failed save, they lose the bonuses granted and you gain the benefit of that bonus until the end of your next turn.
